name: Tamar Selzer
bio: A Tel Aviv based graphic designer. Interested in making sense of the random — somewhere between order and spontaneity. Exploring ways to make complex ideas accessible and engaging.

experience.text: Designer at Sharon Shrem Branding & Design Studio.

education.text: B.Des in Visual Communication, Bezalel Academy of Arts and Design, Jerusalem.
Exchange program in Communication Design, HAW Hamburg, Germany.
